image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass). The armor features a central vertical ridge, curved lateral panels mimicking pectoral muscles, and visible rivets near the top edge. The surface is highly reflective with specular highlights indicating a smooth metal texture. The bottom edge flares out slightly, suggesting a fauld or waist attachment.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar objects like shields or plastrons.
To verify the 3D curvature and ensure the reflective highlights correspond to a physically valid convex surface.
To check for edge bleeding into the background and ensure the object is a single, continuous physical entity.
To detect subtle texture anomalies or 'melting' artifacts often found in AI-generated metallic surfaces.

focus_areas: Structural symmetry of the central ridge
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the specular highlights on the metal surface follow a consistent light source direction. Check if the rivets appear physically attached or merely painted on. Ensure the bottom flare (fauld) connects logically to the main body of the breastplate without geometric distortion.
